title: Crime And Special Branch - Birthday Invitations

page_data.en:
Form No. 3
G. 32,000-I-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：G. I. B. HEADQUARTERS / FILE No. C.I/17 / DATE 5/1/31） File No. ______
West Hongkew Station,
Date January 1, 1931.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Birthday invitations.

Made by ________________ and ________________ Forwarded by Inspector Walker

Sir,
    Reference attached.
    I beg to report I have interviewed C.D.S.121 Wong Sien
Chang, he states" No invitation was sent to any member of the public
by him, in all 37 invitations were sent to different Stations to
detectives whom he has known for many years, as regards the
allegations made on the invitation cards, he denies all knowledge
of same. He assumed that some of the detectives who received them
sent them to the (D.C. C & S.B.) as a case of spite in order to
get him into trouble."
    The above C.D.S. applied for permission to hold the
party which was approved by D.D.Divisions. Application attached.

                                        I am, Sir,
    (C. Lewis)                          Your obedient servant,
    Forwarded                           (签名: B. Walker)
                                        Inspector in charge.
    D.C. "C".
    D.C. Crime & Special Branches
    Information
    Disposing full
                D. C. (Divisions)       JAN 3 1931

表格第3号
G. 32,000-I-30

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：总巡捕房 / 档案号 C.I/17 / 日期 31年1月5日） 档案号 ______
虹口西区捕房，
日期 1931年1月1日。

报告

事由（全称）生日请柬。

由 ________________ 和 ________________ 制作 经沃克（Walker）巡官转呈

先生，
    参见附件。
    谨报告，本人已约谈华探员121号王希昌（Wong Sien Chang），其称：“本人并未向任何公众成员发送请柬，总共37份请柬是发送给各捕房中相识多年的侦探的；至于请柬上所载之指控，本人对此一概不知。本人推测，部分收到请柬的侦探将其送至（犯罪股与特务股副巡长）处，乃是出于恶意，意在给本人制造麻烦。”
    上述华探员曾申请举办该聚会的许可，并获分区副巡长批准。申请书附后。

                                        此致，
    (C. Lewis)                          您顺从的仆人，
    转呈                                (签名: B. Walker)
                                        主管巡官。
    分区副巡长 “C”。
    犯罪股与特务股副巡长
    知悉
    全权处理
                分区副巡长       1931年1月3日

Sir,
Re attached the party
is being paid for by applicant,
two brothers and eight
other relatives. All the
guests will be from Shanghai
with exception of relatives
visiting here with the Mother.

own party, but the application

先生，
关于附件所述聚会，费用由申请人、其两位兄弟及另外八位亲属共同承担。除随母亲来沪探亲的亲属外，所有宾客均来自上海。这并非申请人独自举办的聚会，但因其参与其中，为遵守规章起见，故由其提出申请。

O. Sharman
②

Application of (Rank Initials & Name) C.D.S. 121 Wong Sien Chang
that the Commissioner of Police will be pleased to the undersigned to hold a
birthday party for his mother on the 21/12/30 at the Chue Shing
Lieu Restrauant Canton Road. About 70 invitations will be issued
to friends in the country and in Shanghai. Applicants mother is
70 years of age.

page_data.en:
Translation of the sentences written at the back of an
invitation.

(Undated).

D.C. (C. & S.B.).

Sir,

Formerly we depended for our living upon the
"Hua Wei" lottery which has been rigidly suppressed.
Now invitations have been received from one of your
C.D.S.s (C.D.S. 121 Wong Se Chong attached to West
Hongkew) demanding us to give him a gift of $10.00
each, a sum too heavy for us to bear. It is therefore
requested that you will be kind enough to have the
amount reduced to $3 or $4 which will be within our
ability to arrange.

Chen.

Translation of the sentences written at the back of
another invitation.

(Undated).

Wong Se Chong demands from every opium smoking
den a sum of $6, a sum too heavy for us, poor mortals,
to bear. It is therefore requested that you will be
kind enough to devise some means of relief for us.

Translation of the invitation.

December 21 being the 70th birthday of my mother, a feast
is prepared for your and your family's attendance.

Wong Se Chong.
Time & ) 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. at the Hsu Sing Lor Restaurant
Place ) at Canton Road and at No.715 Gordon Road, my residence.
page_data.zh:
写在一份请柬背面的文字译文。

（无日期）。

犯罪股与特务股副巡长。

先生，

往昔我等赖以生计的
“华威”彩票已被严加取缔。
今收到贵处一名
华探员（隶属西虹口捕房的华探员121号王世昌（Wong Se Chong），见附件）发来的请柬，要求我等每人向其赠送礼金10.00美元，此数额过于沉重，我等难以承受。故恳请阁下开恩，将金额减至3或4美元，此乃我等力所能及之范围。

陈。

另一份请柬背面所写文字译文。

（无日期）。

王世昌向每家鸦片烟馆索取6美元，此数额过于沉重，我等贫苦百姓难以承受。故恳请阁下开恩，设法为我等缓解负担。

请柬译文。

12月21日乃家母七十寿辰，特备薄宴，恭请您及家人光临。

王世昌。
时间 ) 上午11时至晚上10时，地点：广东路聚兴楼餐馆（Hsu Sing Lor Restaurant）
地点 ) 及戈登路715号本人寓所。
